items.title: Stop residential use of garden house
items.quote: Die Wohnnutzung ist bis zum 30.11.2027 vollständig aufzugeben.
items.computation: The letter gives an explicit calendar date for compliance: 30.11.2027. Checking the weekday: 2027-11-30 falls on a Tuesday, a normal business day, so no weekend/holiday shift applies. The date stands as given.

items.title: File Klage (lawsuit) against the Ordnungsverfügung with the Verwaltungsgericht
items.quote: Die Klage ist binnen eines Monats nach der Bekanntgabe dieser Verfügung beim Verwaltungsgericht Musterkirchen, Justizplatz 1, 45879 Musterkirchen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift des Urkundsbeamten der Geschäftsstelle einzureichen; ein Widerspruchsverfahren ist nach § 110 JustG NRW ausgeschlossen.
items.computation: 1) Determine Bekanntgabe (deemed notification) date: the letter is dated 27.09.2027 (a Monday); assuming it was handed to the postal service that same day, the statutory access fiction for administrative acts sent by ordinary domestic mail (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG NRW) deems it received on the third day after posting, i.e. 27.09.2027 + 3 days = 30.09.2027 (a Thursday, a normal business day, so no shift needed). Bekanntgabe = 30.09.2027. 2) Klage period is one month (§ 74 Abs. 1 VwGO) starting the day after the triggering event per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, i.e. from 01.10.2027, and ending per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day of the triggering event (30.09) -> 30.10.2027. 3) Check that end date: 30.10.2027 is a Saturday. Under § 193 BGB the period is extended to the next business day: 31.10.2027 is a Sunday (still non-business); 01.11.2027 (Allerheiligen) is a statutory public holiday in Nordrhein-Westfalen, so still non-business; the next business day is 02.11.2027 (Tuesday). Therefore the lawsuit must reach the Verwaltungsgericht by 02.11.2027.

warnings: The exact date the authority actually handed the letter to the post office is not stated; the Klage deadline (02.11.2027) assumes dispatch occurred on the document date (27.09.2027) — if it was posted later, the deadline shifts accordingly and should be verified against the envelope postmark if available.
A Zwangsgeld (coercive fine) of €1,500.00 is only threatened (angedroht) as a consequence of non-compliance with the 30.11.2027 deadline; it is not itself currently due.
